integrity: Every finite verification result is identified as corroboration; the all-order proof uses exact convexity and hyperbolic inequalities. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unit-edge K_{1,n}, n>=3, real Lipschitz functions; gives the entire sharp centered Laplace envelope and optimizer phase transitions, not a closed elementary sub-Gaussian quadratic proxy or an extension to weighted stars and other trees. Equivalent unindexed prior formulations remain possible.
title: Sharp tilted concentration on uniform star graphs: a staircase of leaf-sign extremizers
